body:
Artists and designers spend a lot of time working in front of their computers, and we all know how tiring and burdensome it is, especially to our backs.

Actually, once you get to have a conversation with creatives, there are definitely a handful of them who are experiencing body and back pain issues.

‍If you’re also one of those people, then you’re probably thinking...

What’s the best chair to buy for graphic designers in 2024?

The market today consists of a lot of chairs that are said to be ‘the best’—but in reality, the answer to this question is still subjective and will depend on what would suit you best.

‍But with all of my years spent in the creative industry, there are a couple of factors that I learned on how to distinguish which chair would be best for a specific purpose.‍

To be specific, the Flexispot C7 is the best value for money chair for graphic designers that I suggest.

The Alera Elusion is a great choice too, especially for professionals that are looking for a high-end chair.

‍So without further ado, here’s my list of the 11 best chairs for graphic designers to buy this year.

Do you want to add your product to the list?—Find my address on the contact page and send your product for review.

  1. FlexiSpot C7—Best value for money
  2. Herman Miller Aeron—Best overall
  3. Herman Miller Embody—Most luxurious
  4. Alera Elusion— Best value for money

  9. Duramont Ergonomic Chair—Best budget-friendly

How to choose the best chairs for graphic designers

Whether you’re trying to get your first chair or having an upgrade, there's always a possibility that you'll lose out on a part, function, or feature of a chair that you didn't realize you needed.

So to help you avoid wasting your hard-earned money, try to follow the the four main important factors that I consider in choosing the best chairs:

  1. Budget
  2. Ergonomic Design
  3. Adjustability
  4. Build Quality

Now let me briefly explain each of these factors and why they matter in having a productive graphic design workflow.‍

Budget

First and foremost, the budget is the most deciding factor when doing any kind of purchase.

As per usual, having a bigger budget will open you to wider choices and selections of chairs.

Regardless of your budget, there is always a good chair that would be matched to your money.‍

Ergonomic Design

As all creative work requires a long time of sitting in front of the computer, it’s extremely important to get a chair that’s ergonomically designed.

The right type of comfortable-to-use chair will allow you to move your body freely, give you 360 degrees of mobility, and ensure your neck is relaxed and in a neutral position.

One of the most common assets that a good ergonomic chair has is lumbar support, which supports the inward curve of the lower back, preventing common back issues.

Adjustability

Next factor that you should consider is the adjustability options of the chair—even if different chairs have their own designs, it still needs to adapt to your needs.

One of the most important adjustability options that you should have on a chair is for the backrest to be good for reclining and tilting, as this prevents a static position and increases blood flow.

The most common features that a lot of chairs lack are the armrests and lumbar support adjustments, which are critical for proper alignment and proportion.

Lumbar support adjustment lets your whole back be properly aligned to your neck, while armrests adjustment allows your arms to be in a proper angle and proportion.gle and proportion.

Build Quality

Of course, no matter how great the ergonomics and adjustability options that a chair has, the most determining factor is its build quality.

It’s always great to check on what type of fabric, metal, leather, and other materials your chair is made of.

Lastly, if you’re on the heavier side, choosing a chair with a higher maximum weight load capacity will be best to prevent any serious injuries.

Now that I’ve explained to you the most important things that I always look up when choosing the best chairs, here are the top 11 best chairs for graphic designers according to my choice.

1. FlexiSpot C7 Ergonomic Chair

The FlexiSpot C7 Ergonomic Chair is renowned as one of the best chairs that enhance comfort and productivity in the workplace.

The best value for money chair that ensures optimal spinal alignment in any sitting position.

The C7 intuitively adapts to your body's natural contours, proving steadfast support in any sitting position.

The chair comes with an adjustable headrest that provides optimal support for your neck and head, enhancing comfort during extended periods of sitting.

Its 3D armrests offer customizable support for your arms and shoulders, promoting proper ergonomics and reducing strain.

Additionally, the chair features a highly adjustable backrest for optimal comfort and support, with an optional footrest for enhanced relaxation during extended sitting.

The C7 has passed BIFMA testing for strength and stability, and its affordability makes it accessible to more people.

It has the ability to hold a weight capacity of 320 lbs and it also comes with a 10-year warranty.

The chair's large 20-inch seat offers plenty of space, allowing for comfortable seating even during extended periods of use.

Moreover, the seat of this chair is available in both foam and breathable mesh options, providing flexibility in comfort preferences.

The FlexiSpot C7 also features a dynamic lumbar support cushion, which adjusts to your movements, providing continuous support and promoting proper spinal alignment for enhanced comfort and reduced fatigue.

Thanks to its innovative design, durability, and affordability, the FlexiSpot C7 suits any professional working environment. It's also my favorite chair.

2. Herman Miller Aeron

It’s no secret that Herman Miller products are the golden standards when it comes to ergonomic chairs, and it all started with the Herman Miller Aeron.

‍The best overall office chair for graphic designers.

‍The Herman Miller Aeron is an iconic chair that offers excellent ergonomic features and award-winning design that are built for long working hours.

After its original release in 1994 as the first ergonomic chair ever designed, the Herman Miller Aeron still preserves its original design until today.

This chair comes in a series of color and form factor combinations from black, mineral, carbon, aluminum, and graphite, that are all available in three different sizes.

The Herman Miller Aeron is definitely a great choice for creatives that are looking for the best chair for designers and artists.

‍Breathability won’t also be an issue with the Herman Miller Aeron as it’s made with breathable fabric that can keep you cool and comfortable while working.

‍It also boasts adjustability with its Posture Fit SL feature for lumbar support, a Harmonic Tilt that supports natural movements and smooth recline.

And its fully adjustable arm rest that you can customize the height, depth, and angle.

The Herman Miller Aeron  has been an icon for its comfort design and durability, that’s why it’s been sold for over 8 million customers already.

3. Herman Miller Embody

The most luxurious graphic design chair in 2022.

Luxury isn’t just by the great looks of the Herman Miller Embody, but it’s mainly the mobility and freedom that it allows its users to have while helping them lessen the muscle tension.

Designed with the input of more than 30 physicians and PhDs in different fields, the Herman Miller Embody combines the body’s active and passive ergonomics.

The Herman Miller Embody is actually an ideal choice for people who wants to buy a stylish chair for graphic design.

‍This chair has a Backfit adjustment feature that lets you manually fine-tune the chair according to your spine and ribs.

And its pixelated support will naturally adapt to your micro-movements and eliminate the pressure buildup.

‍The Herman Miller Embody is made from a die-cast aluminum frame, a five-star base, and its seat has four breathable layers that’s made for comfort and better airflow.

Despite its steep price similar to the Herman Miller Aeron, the Herman Miller Embody offers some great features that anyone can definitely benefit from.

‍The best value office chair for graphic designers.

‍Having a great quality office chair with some nice features shouldn’t always cost you thousands of Dollars, and this is what the Alera Elusion is trying to prove.

‍Even with its price, this chair packs up an attractive and ergonomic design that will be a great fit to multiple users.

Comfort won’t be an issue with the Alera Elusion because of its multiple recline and tension options that can be easily adjusted to your body.

This chair’s multifunction mechanism allows adjustment for back angle and forward tilting, which helps you get the most comfortable position.

Additionally, the Alera Elusion is a perfect choice for creatives that are looking for the best high-end graphic design chair.

5. Razer Iskur

There should always be a separate time for work and playing games, but the Razer Iskur can do both of those things at the same time.

‍The Razer Iskur is the best gaming chair for designers.

‍If you’re a graphic designer who enjoys blowing off some after work steam through playing games, the Razer Iskur is the best chair for your needs.

Debunking the common belief that gaming chairs can’t be good office chairs, it has been designed for the comfort of gamers who spend a lot of hours in front of the computer.

It has a fully adjustable ergonomic lumbar curve that aligns your spine, ensuring an ideal posture throughout the long hours of working.

Also, the Razer Iskur is an excellent choice for creatives and hobbyists that are looking for the best chair for gaming.

‍Durability is one of the best assets of this chair, as it comes in a multi-layered PVC synthetic leather, which is designed to withstand the wear and tear from every day use.

The seat of the Razer Iskur is made from plush, high density foam cushions, which provides a perfect balance of support and comfort.

‍It also boasts 4D armrests that can be moved up and down, left and right, and twisted inward or outward to meet your desired angle and position.

‍A bonus feature that comes with this chair is the memory foam head cushion, which molds to the shape of your head to give you support and comfort.

‍In addition to its gaming chair design, the Razer Iskur is available in three colors and two sizes.

The cushion of the Sihoo Ergonomic Chair is a “W type” high strength sponge that gives a good and comfortable feeling when you’re sitting down.

Overall, the Sihoo Ergonomic Chair is an amazing choice for graphic designers that are looking for a comfortable-to-use chair.

Conclusions

So which chair do you think is the best for graphic designers? I personally prefer the FlexiSpot C7 as the best chair for graphic designers.

For the longest time, the chairs from Herman Miller have been the most trusted by a lot of people in the creative industry.

But of course, if you’re just trying to look for your first office chair or you have a tight budget, getting the Herman Miller Aeron, Herman Miller Embody, and even the Humanscale Freedom should not be on your priority right now.

What I can recommend you to do is if you already have your set aside budget for a chair, list down all of the functions and features that you want to have.

Do you want to have a chair that would be great for both work and gaming like the Razer Iskur?A multi-function chair like the Sihoo Ergonomic Chair?

Or maybe you’re on the heavier side, so the BOLISS Big and Tall Office Chair and Steelcase Series 2 Office Chair would be better for you?

The list I’ve provided here was broad, so there’s definitely a chair that would be the best for your current needs and wants.
